scope: Agentic spreadsheet protocol only. All 433 released identifiers and projected task metadata inventoried; no answer column or biological fixtures used for authoring. Task-specific evidence and independence remain unvalidated.

source_grading.review: Implementation inspected, not executed. Exact/case-normalized answer checks, OMIM_ID equality, or nonempty gene-list intersection. No LLM judge in this evaluator. Answer extraction from tagged text is a separate adapter concern.

overlap_note: The 100 LAB-Bench question instances are derived from original LAB-Bench categories. Global instance_id differs from task-specific task_instance_id; use the compound source task name and task-specific ID. Shared evidence and question overlap across GWAS categories are unassessed.

gwas-variant-evidence.scientific_decision: Prioritize a candidate variant for a phenotype from reproducible evidence.
required_stages: compare the provided candidates using explicit evidence rules
remaining_gaps: A matched rs identifier is the source endpoint; an offline recipe still needs frozen evidence and a justified deterministic ranking rule.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

gwas-causal-gene-evidence.scientific_decision: Prioritize a candidate gene for a phenotype and locus.
required_stages: join versioned gene and trait evidence
distinguish association, proximity and causal support
report a candidate ranking with supporting evidence
remaining_gaps: The three source categories use different evidence origins. Database association or nearest-gene selection alone does not establish causality; source-specific access and overlap need review.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

screen-context-gene-retrieval.scientific_decision: Find a gene supported by perturbation-screen evidence in the stated context.
required_stages: identify the relevant study and assay context
align screen, cell, condition and gene identifiers
define effect direction and compare candidates
preserve supporting measurements and a selected gene
remaining_gaps: Individual study contexts and their data lineage are unreviewed. Use independently sourced observations; do not copy benchmark candidate lists or expected hits.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

phenotype-gene-prioritization.scientific_decision: Prioritize a candidate gene from a phenotype profile.
required_stages: normalize HPO terms and candidate identifiers
score candidates with explicit missingness and inheritance assumptions
return the selected gene and reproducible ranking
remaining_gaps: The official check accepts any intersection with expected genes. Training verification must also constrain unsupported extra predictions and validate the underlying evidence.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

rare-disease-evidence.scientific_decision: Rank candidate disease hypotheses from phenotype and gene evidence.
required_stages: normalize HPO and candidate gene identifiers
rank disease hypotheses and retain supporting evidence
remaining_gaps: The source checks OMIM_ID equality. Licensed evidence access, independent observations and deterministic ranking remain unresolved; this is a research task rather than a clinical diagnosis.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

delivery-method-selection.scientific_decision: Choose a delivery category consistent with stated biological constraints.
required_stages: record the selected category and evidence
remaining_gaps: A categorical answer has an executable check, but a new real-data task requires defensible selection rules and cannot assume a unique best method without context.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

restriction-digest.scientific_decision: Reconcile enzyme cut sites with digest fragments.
required_stages: resolve sequence topology and enzyme definitions
remaining_gaps: Use independent observed sequences, frozen enzyme definitions and complete fragment artifacts; circularity and Type IIS cut offsets must be explicit.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

orf-analysis.scientific_decision: Identify open reading frames and derive the requested protein property.
required_stages: declare strands, reading frames and genetic code
find starts and stops under explicit ORF rules
translate and resolve the requested residue or protein
remaining_gaps: Use real genomic observations and explicit tie, partial-ORF and coordinate conventions; benchmark strings are excluded.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

amplicon-reconstruction.scientific_decision: Choose or evaluate a primer pair against its sequence template.
required_stages: align both primer-binding regions with strand orientation
reconcile the requested candidate pair or product
remaining_gaps: Use independent real sequence templates and complete binding/product artifacts; a multiple-choice label alone does not validate sequence reconstruction.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

gibson-primer-compatibility.scientific_decision: Assess compatibility of amplification primers with an intended assembly.
required_stages: resolve versioned insert and vector sequences
remaining_gaps: Pin independent benign source sequences and validate the complete reconstructed product, including junctions; source candidate strings are excluded.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

restriction-cloning-compatibility.scientific_decision: Assess cloning compatibility of primers, enzymes, insert and vector.
required_stages: evaluate restriction sites and cut orientation
remaining_gaps: Independent source sequence, topology, internal-cut handling and complete product validation remain required.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

sequence-gc.scientific_decision: Compute a sequence composition quantity with explicit denominator and rounding.
remaining_gaps: Observed data and a connected scientific purpose are needed; a short constructed sequence count is only a component.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

translation-context.scientific_decision: Compare sequence contexts relevant to translation initiation.
required_stages: state the limits of sequence-only prediction
remaining_gaps: A heuristic context score does not measure translation efficiency. An independently observed assay or explicitly limited deterministic feature task is needed.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

gene-set-membership.scientific_decision: Resolve candidate gene membership in a named annotation set.
required_stages: pin the annotation collection and release
retain provenance and select the supported candidate
remaining_gaps: Freeze the relevant annotation release; source questions sometimes describe collection membership and must be checked against the actual database.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

clinical-variant-evidence.scientific_decision: Reconcile sequence variants with recorded clinical evidence.
required_stages: resolve reference sequence and variant identity
remaining_gaps: Independent observed variants, sequence-version mapping and conflict handling are required. A database label is evidence, not a new clinical conclusion.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

promoter-binding-query.scientific_decision: Resolve binding annotations against an explicitly defined promoter interval.
required_stages: pin genome, gene and binding releases
join binding sites to candidate promoters
return overlap evidence and candidate identity
remaining_gaps: A generic interval overlap is insufficient without the correct reference, TSS choice and empirical binding source.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

interaction-database-query.scientific_decision: Resolve a stated interaction relation in a versioned biological database.
required_stages: query the specified release and relation
remaining_gaps: Database predictions do not demonstrate physical interaction. Independent data, source permissions and biologically appropriate task subjects require review.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

cytoband-gene-query.scientific_decision: Map gene candidates to a chromosome band in a named reference release.
required_stages: join gene coordinates to band intervals
remaining_gaps: Reference releases and band-boundary conventions must match; generic coordinate handling alone is insufficient.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

mirna-target-query.scientific_decision: Retrieve a candidate target under a specified microRNA prediction release.
required_stages: return the stated prediction with provenance
remaining_gaps: Predicted targeting is distinct from experimental regulation; an offline recipe needs an independent versioned source.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.

disease-database-difference.scientific_decision: Reconcile disease-gene relations present in one database but absent in another.
required_stages: align gene identifiers and release dates
preserve both positive and absent-source evidence
remaining_gaps: Absence depends on resource coverage and release. Licensed evidence access and identifier equivalence must be resolved.
Validate the connected analysis and complete artifacts on independent real observations; no implementation credit is assigned from a topic match.
